notes: static_observed describes source declarations, never runtime reachability; exposure is inferred or unknown.
Same-file context and repository counts do not establish route ownership or auth enforcement.
Low-quality paths (tests/fixtures/mocks/examples) are retained in raw signals but separated in evidence class counts.
Use this artifact as a triage source-of-truth; validate high-priority items with repository context and runtime controls.
Assets, controls, and notable observations are heuristic overlays; absent-control entries indicate scanner did not find evidence, not necessarily that the control is missing in production.

ATT&CK technique mappings and detection opportunities are derived from insight kinds and finding-title keywords; treat them as triage hooks for SIEM/detection-engineering work, not authoritative MITRE mappings.

claim_support fields are closed-set token checks: supported_by_cited_evidence only means the cited evidence text names an identifier, route, or secret-kind the claim names; they never verify a claim's conclusion, and not_assessed never means a claim is false.

analyzer_metadata_used.name: python
analyzer_metadata_used.description: Comprehensive Python analyzer for Django, Starlette, AIOHTTP, Sanic, Litestar, DRF; SQLAlchemy/asyncpg/motor; passlib/PyJWT/authlib; httpx/aiohttp.
analyzer_metadata_used.scope: Python projects (pyproject.toml, setup.py, manage.py, or any *.py tree). Additive over the built-in python-web analyzer.

analyzer_metadata_used.name: python-web
analyzer_metadata_used.description: Built-in analyzer for Python web frameworks and related security signals.
analyzer_metadata_used.scope: Python source files handled by the current scanner-backed web heuristics.

analyzer_metadata_used.name: config
analyzer_metadata_used.description: Broad built-in analyzer for YAML / TOML / JSON / INI / .env application config files.
analyzer_metadata_used.scope: Application config files. Extracts DB connection strings, external service URLs, and secret-shaped literals; deep IaC parsing (docker-compose service graph, Dockerfile hardening) lives in attackmap-analyzer-iac.

analyzer_metadata_used.name: python-service
analyzer_metadata_used.description: Framework-enrichment overlay for Python web services (FastAPI/Flask/Django/Celery cross-file wiring).
analyzer_metadata_used.scope: Python web-service repositories; adds cross-file router/blueprint/URLconf wiring, framework auth semantics, ORM scoping, and service-boundary signals on top of the per-file python-web pass.

analyzer_metadata_used.name: default
analyzer_metadata_used.description: Fallback built-in analyzer for code file suffixes not claimed by a specialized built-in.
analyzer_metadata_used.scope: Any CODE_EXTENSIONS suffix not covered by python-web or javascript-web.

handling.default: down-rank low-quality signals in triage and prioritization

handling.operator_note: do not treat low-quality-only evidence as strong production exposure without corroboration
